title: Lathe, running down
summary: Forty-one seconds from cut-off to stop, most of it below the range in which a note has a name.

body.text: A 1948 machine with a considerable amount of rotating mass and no brake. When the power goes off it takes forty-one seconds to stop, and it does not do so smoothly: there are two points at which the pitch drops noticeably faster, which are presumably bearings, and one point near the end where it very briefly speeds up, which is not.
The archive has been unable to account for the acceleration and has stopped trying to. It happens every time.
